deterministic_policy: Tables and figures render one fingerprinted projection with fixed ordering, formatting, geometry, colours, fonts, and timestamp-free metadata.
escaping_policy: Escape every LaTeX control character and XML metacharacter after collapsing whitespace and redacting absolute local path tokens.
latex_environment: self-contained table fragment using only LaTeX2e tabular and hline
limitations: Figures are compact deterministic publication aids, not interactive charts.
Numeric figures use a shared signed linear scale and do not imply favourability.
Rule figures show categorical statuses and do not convert confidence into probability.
Long cells and non-scalar values are bounded for dissertation table readability.
Final dissertation layout and captions still require researcher review.
path_policy: Rendered content and receipts contain artifact identifiers and basenames only; absolute local input/output paths are never embedded.
scientific_boundary: REP-01 renders already-computed typed artifacts and performs no metric, comparison, statistical, diagnostic, ranking, or causal calculation.
source_mode_policy: Every table and figure states synthetic, imported/non-synthetic, or unresolved.
